paragraphs: Rav Adda of Sura told Rabbi Chanina of Sura, etc., chapter Tinoket 67b: may a woman wash and comb her hair at night and immerse at night? Mar Zutra forbids; Rabbi Chanina of Sura permits. Rav Adda of Sura told Rav Chanina of the incident involving Abba Mari the exilarch’s wife, who quarreled (דאיקוט: a quarrel, and she did not wish to immerse). Rav Nachman bar Yitzchak went to appease her.
